Phase 1 package is complete, committed as `54e6de0`. No game, no search, no training was run. Human study pending.

## Deliverables (owned files only)
- `campaign/setups/phase-1.json` — 96 explicit legal full-board setups: 64 mirror (`P1-001…064`) + 32 asymmetric (`P1-065…096`), full FENs + `fenSwapped` (colour-and-rank mirror), coverage block, deterministic pair/colour mapping.
- `campaign/setups/phase-1-generate.ts` — retained deterministic generator (reproduces setups, specs, pinned arm).
- `campaign/specs/phase-1-archer-adopted/classic.proposed.json` — single-rule A/B (`plusDiagFwd2` vs `classic`), identical setups/seed, all other rules frozen.
- `campaign/specs/phase-1-eval-linear-vs-residual.proposed.json`, `…-deep-linear.proposed.json` — per-side `evalParams`, `pairs: true`, deeper-linear depth-proxy check.
- `campaign/specs/phase-1-residual-eval.json` — pinned campaign arm embedding the exact adopted Q6 blob bytes in the existing `EvalParams` format.
- `campaign/specs/phase-1-beast-guard-focus.proposed.json`, `phase-1-throughput-d3/d4.proposed.json`.
- `campaign/protocols/phase-1.md` — hypotheses, endpoints, SWE, clustered uncertainty, caps-vs-endings, budget ≤10,000, stopping/expansion rules, commands, gates.
- `campaign/phase-1-protocol-report.md` — checklist, evidence, limitations, gates.
- `campaign/verify-phase-1.ts` — validator.

## Exact checks
`node_modules/.bin/tsx campaign/verify-phase-1.ts` → **98 PASS / 0 FAIL, exit 0**; `sourceId = 3545663dcf97`.

- Setups: every FEN round-trips, one king per side, no pawn on back rank, no lab piece, status `playing`, ≥1 legal move; `fenSwapped` equals the independent mirror. 71 distinct White compositions; 61 both-archer; 73 both-beast; 54 guard.
- Specs: `buildJobs(spec).length == games`; one config per setup; pair/colour mapping correct; all job FENs are frozen setups; `usePairs` true; `adjudicate: false`. specKeys recorded.
- Archer arms: exactly one differing rule (`archerShots`); adopted arm equals current defaults.
- Residual: `netLoaded=true`, `netKind=residual`, `sha256(b64)=e17a27bf…` matches the accepted Q6 model; applied on 94/96 setups (`mean|Δ|=21.10`, `max|Δ|=50`, no clip overflow); Ogre fallback Δ=0; pinned arm byte-identical.

## True remaining gates
- **T1**: confirmation depth/time pending the supervisor-reviewed M1 throughput probes; depth 4 is a placeholder, nothing claimed validated.
- **S1**: in-check quiescence stall reproducer/fix is a prerequisite owned elsewhere.
- **E1**: head-to-head setup-clustered cluster bootstrap is not implemented in `src/sim/analyze.ts`.
- Noted limits: both archer arms keep shipped `ARCHER_V` (no re-pricing); `sim/nnue/net.json` does not reproduce the committed blob (do not regenerate arms from it); repository `sim/nnue/eval-residual.json` unpinned (replaced by the campaign pinned arm; source files untouched).

No startup/contract files were staged. Total campaign games played: 0.
